subject: Follow-up: supplemental pen test deliverables and compensating control evidence
messages:
From: Lynn Patterson <lynn.patterson@acme-fin.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: pen test report + remediation artifacts for audit

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Our internal audit is closing out the pen test milestone for the Acme production integration and we need a few deliverables to sign off: the final penetration test report (if available), evidence that the critical issue SecureLabs flagged (operator kv-cache exposure) was remediated, and any compensating controls or config screenshots.

Specifically, please provide:
- The pen test report (or redacted executive summary)
- Screenshot(s) of the fixed config and the verification step you used
- JIRA ticket(s) or change requests showing closure with timestamps
- Confirmation of log retention and access controls for the relevant service

We understand some items may be sensitive; a redacted report and artifacts with minimal PII/paths are fine. Target is to have this in our evidence folder by Dec 10. Let me know if you need more time or a template for the audit packet.

Best,
Lynn Patterson
Principal Security Manager, Acme Financial
lynn.patterson@acme-fin.com

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Lynn Patterson <lynn.patterson@acme-fin.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + remediation artifacts for audit

Hi Lynn — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely provide the materials. Quick summary of what we’ll deliver and schedule: 

What we will provide:
- Redacted SecureLabs executive report (PDF) 
- Screenshots of the config change that removed KV cache exposure
- Links and screenshots of the JIRA ticket (RED-3421) showing remediation and verification steps
- Short memo describing compensating controls (access controls, runtime RBAC, automated KV prefix filtering)
- Retention policy excerpt for secure logs + confirmation of S3 lifecycle rules

Owners: Mina (Security) will assemble the report artifacts; Marissa (Engineering) owns the ticket and will export screenshots/configs. Neha (Customer Success) is copied for delivery coordination.

Timing: we expect to drop a redacted PDF and artifacts into the shared evidence folder by 2026-12-07. If you need earlier or different formats (DocuSign, ZIP, or scanned signature page), tell us.

Attaching: a short redwood PT summary (internal) to help set expectations — full SecureLabs report will be redacted.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_pt_summary_20261130.pdf

From: Lynn Patterson <lynn.patterson@acme-fin.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 08:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + remediation artifacts for audit

Aditya,

Appreciate the update — this looks good. A couple of follow-ups from the audit checklist: 
- For the config screenshot, can we get an image that includes the timestamp (server time) and the exact parameter name (so auditors can map it to the control)?
- For the JIRA evidence, the auditors prefer a changelog capture and the "verified by" entry. A link is fine but a PDF or screenshot of the ticket activity log is ideal.
- Regarding logs: we need the retention period and who has access (list of roles), plus the S3 prefix path where the logs are stored (redacted is fine).

If you can place these into the SharePoint folder I shared (link below) or send a ZIP, we’ll mark the item closed on our side. Thanks.

Lynn

Related folder: https://acme-fin.sharepoint.com/:f:/s/SecTeam/EvidenceFolder/pt-2026

From: mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Lynn Patterson <lynn.patterson@acme-fin.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 11:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + remediation artifacts for audit

Hi Lynn — looping in Marissa who implemented the change and will attach the verification artifacts. Per your checklist we will provide: 

1) Timestamped screenshot of the runtime config that removed the kv-prefix exposure (attached PNG).
2) PDF export of the JIRA ticket RED-3421 (includes changelog and "verified by" entry).
3) Small config excerpt (kv-cache policy lines) showing the updated rule.
4) Log retention excerpt and roles list (we’ve redacted account IDs).

We’re publishing these to the folder you referenced. For S3 storage we can provide the prefix path with a wildcard and remove exact bucket names if you prefer redaction. Please confirm preferred redaction level (full bucket removed vs. path-only).

Attachments included: jira-RED-3421-closure-screenshot.png, kv-cache-config-2026-11-29.txt

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Staff Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lynn Patterson <lynn.patterson@acme-fin.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 14:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + remediation artifacts for audit

Lynn — uploaded the items to your SharePoint folder and copied a small evidence bundle here. Summary of artifacts uploaded:

- jira-RED-3421-closure-screenshot.png (shows changelog, status changed to Resolved, and "verified by: M. Cole" with timestamp 2026-11-29T16:02:43Z)
- kv-cache-config-2026-11-29.txt (config excerpt with kv_prefix_blacklist rule applied)
- securelogs-retention-policy.pdf (redacted excerpt showing 365-day retention for audit logs and RBAC roles: SRE, SecOps, AuditReadOnly)
- redwood_pt_summary_20261130.pdf (redacted executive summary from SecureLabs)

Notes: We redacted bucket names but left S3 prefixes (e.g., /logs/prod/inference/*). If you need an unredacted path for engineering reasons, we can provide it under an NDA or via your security console access.

Let us know if anything else is needed to close the audit item.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Software Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment links:
https://acme-fin.sharepoint.com/:f:/s/SecTeam/EvidenceFolder/pt-2026
https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-3421
